content.short: Seam Social is a Web3 platform for designing, coding, and curating MySpace-like profiles.
content.description: Seam Social is a Web3 social platform that fuses the personalization vibe of MySpace with the collaborative spirit of Facebook Groups. Seam Social provides an open-source block development SDK that enables users to create custom features and themes for themselves and their friends, encouraging personal expression and shared experiences within the community. It also supports mini social profiles tailored to Web3 games, allowing players to showcase NFTs, add friends, and embed playlists directly in-game to enrich interactions across titles.
content.meta: Seam Social is a Web3 social platform. Discover Seam Social and other Web3 Social Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
